resources.string: MemoTrip collects only the information needed to create your account, run trip planning features, display your trips, support KroniQ collaboration, and improve the reliability and security of the app. By using the app, you agree that this information may be processed as described below.

We may collect account information such as your name, e-mail address, profile image, account type, authentication details, and settings preferences. We also store trip information that you create in the app, including destinations, dates, transport choices, notes, checklist items, budget values, gallery photos, and KroniQ member or guest assignments.

We use your data to authenticate your account, save your trips, sync your content across devices, display profile and KroniQ information, process subscriptions, and support product features such as trip planning, collaboration, and gallery management. We may also use technical logs to diagnose failures, fix bugs, and keep the service stable.

When you create or edit trips, the app stores the places, routes, dates, and related metadata that you enter. This data is used to generate trip details, route previews, and map visualizations. Location data is processed to provide app functionality and is not collected in the background unless a specific future feature requires it.

If you upload profile photos, KroniQ images, trip cover images, or gallery photos, those files are stored on our backend storage providers and linked to your account or trip content. Uploaded media is used only to display and manage the content you choose to save in the app.

If you add members or guests to KroniQ, the app processes the related account identifiers, role assignments, and shared trip visibility settings. Guests may receive temporary access according to the product rules configured for the feature. You are responsible for adding only users you intend to share content with.

If you use paid plans such as Premium or KroniQ, we process subscription status and plan entitlements so the app can unlock the correct features. Payment execution itself may be handled by third-party billing providers. We do not store more payment data than is needed to confirm plan access and manage account status.

Some current or future features may use AI-assisted processing to help with trip planning, route generation, exports, or similar assistance workflows. When such features are used, the relevant trip content may be processed to produce the requested result. AI outputs can be imperfect and should be reviewed by the user before relying on them.

We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your account and content. No system is perfectly secure, but we aim to limit access, secure authentication flows, and reduce unnecessary data exposure. Uploaded files, authentication tokens, and account data should still be treated as sensitive information.

You can update profile information, change uploaded content, remove certain trip content, and manage some sharing settings directly in the app. Depending on the feature, you may also be able to request account changes or deletion. If a setting is not editable in the UI, it may require a separate support or legal request.

If you need support with privacy, account access, or data-related requests, use the support channel listed in the app or the project contact information provided by MemoTrip. Privacy requests should include enough detail to identify the account involved and the action requested.
This in-app privacy policy screen should be reviewed and approved before public release. If you need a legally finalized text, replace this content with the officially approved version.
These terms govern your use of MemoTrip and KroniQ. By creating an account or using the app, you agree to use the service responsibly and according to the product rules described below.

You are responsible for the account you use in the app and for keeping your login credentials secure. You must provide accurate account information and you may not access the service using another person’s identity without authorization.

You may use the app only for lawful and legitimate travel planning, collaboration, and content management purposes. You may not misuse the service, attempt unauthorized access, interfere with other users, or use the app in a way that harms the product, infrastructure, or other users.

You are responsible for the destinations, notes, budgets, checklist items, images, and other trip content you create or upload. You should review all trip data before relying on it. The app helps organize information, but you remain responsible for your actual travel decisions.

If you use KroniQ, you are responsible for the users you add as members or guests and for the trip content you share with them. Temporary guest access, member management, and shared visibility features must be used intentionally. Do not grant access to users unless you want them to see the relevant shared content.

Some features may require Premium or KroniQ access. Subscription availability, billing, renewals, and plan changes may be handled by platform billing providers or other payment partners. Access to paid functionality depends on successful subscription validation and may change if a subscription expires or is cancelled.

MemoTrip may provide AI-assisted features such as trip planning, routing support, or future export generation. AI results are assistive outputs, not guarantees. You are responsible for reviewing generated content and deciding whether it is correct, safe, and appropriate for your use case.

You retain responsibility for the content you upload, including photos and shared trip data. By uploading content into the app, you grant the service the limited right to store, process, and display that content as needed to provide the product features you use.

We aim to keep the app available and functional, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted operation. Features may change, be updated, or be temporarily unavailable due to maintenance, technical issues, security needs, or product changes.

MemoTrip is provided as a product tool for organization and planning. To the maximum extent allowed by law, the service is provided without guarantees of uninterrupted availability, perfect accuracy, or suitability for every travel scenario. You remain responsible for your decisions, bookings, routes, and real-world activities.

These terms may be updated as the product evolves. Continued use of the app after changes means you accept the updated rules. Material changes should be reviewed before public release and reflected in the legal text used by the product.
This in-app terms screen is a product draft and should be reviewed before release. If a legally approved version exists, replace this content with the final official text.

This section explains how paid plans such as Premium and KroniQ are handled in MemoTrip. Access to paid features depends on a valid subscription or purchase state recognized by the app and its billing providers.

MemoTrip may offer free and paid plans with different levels of access. Premium and KroniQ plans can unlock additional features such as advanced collaboration, shared experiences, or other paid functionality. Available features may change as the product evolves.

Payments may be processed by third-party billing platforms or payment providers rather than directly by the app itself. In those cases, the provider’s billing terms, payment methods, and transaction rules also apply to the purchase you make.

If a plan is subscription-based, it may renew automatically according to the billing rules of the relevant store or provider, unless cancelled before the renewal date. You are responsible for reviewing your active subscriptions and managing them through the correct billing channel.

Cancelling a subscription generally stops future renewals but does not automatically revoke access for the already paid period, unless the billing platform states otherwise. Cancellation handling may depend on the store or provider through which the subscription was purchased.

Refund eligibility depends on the billing provider, app store, or payment platform that processed the transaction. MemoTrip may not be able to grant direct refunds when the payment was handled externally. In such cases, refund requests must follow the platform’s own rules.

Paid feature access depends on valid plan verification. If a purchase expires, fails, is revoked, or cannot be validated, the app may limit access to Premium or KroniQ features until the subscription status is restored.

If billing validation fails or a charge is not completed, the related feature access may not activate or may be interrupted. Temporary store errors, network failures, or payment issues can affect subscription state until a successful verification occurs.

MemoTrip may change plan structure, pricing, or included features over time. Any such changes should follow the rules of the relevant billing provider and should be reflected in the product and legal text before public release.
This screen is a product draft and should be aligned with the final billing implementation and approved legal wording before release.

MemoTrip may use AI-assisted features to support planning, route generation, and future export workflows. This notice explains the practical limits of those features and how users should treat AI-generated results inside the app.

AI may be used to support trip planning, route suggestions, map-related generation, exports, or other assistance features introduced in the product over time. AI is provided as a helper layer, not as a guaranteed source of truth.

When you use an AI-driven feature, relevant trip content may be processed to generate the requested output. Depending on the feature, this can include destinations, travel dates, transport choices, route information, notes, or other trip-related context entered by the user.

AI outputs are generated automatically and may vary even for similar inputs. The app may present suggestions, route structures, or generated content that look plausible but still require user review before being treated as correct or final.

AI-generated content can be incomplete, inaccurate, outdated, or inconsistent. It may not reflect real-world route restrictions, opening times, weather conditions, booking availability, legal requirements, or safety constraints. You are responsible for checking important information independently.

Do not rely solely on AI-generated suggestions when making travel, transport, budget, or safety decisions. MemoTrip provides organizational support, but you remain responsible for verifying routes, destinations, reservations, local rules, and other practical travel details.
6. AI in Exports and Generated Content

If the app offers AI-assisted exports or generated summaries, those outputs may contain formatting issues, omissions, or incorrect interpretations of your trip data. Generated exports should be reviewed before sharing, publishing, or using them for important decisions.

AI functionality may change as the product evolves. Features can be updated, improved, limited, or removed based on technical, product, or legal requirements. The exact AI models or providers used by the service may also change over time.
This in-app notice is a product draft and should be aligned with the final AI implementation and approved legal wording before release.
Deleting an account is a high-impact action. It can affect your profile, trips, uploaded content, shared KroniQ access, and any related account history connected to MemoTrip.

Account deletion can affect your profile data, trip content, uploaded media, collaboration settings, and access to Premium or KroniQ features. Depending on the final backend implementation, some data may be deleted immediately and some may remain temporarily for legal, billing, security, or audit reasons.

If account deletion is completed, you should expect to lose access to the deleted account and to the content tied to it. Shared or collaborative content may also be impacted where your account is the owner or a required participant.
Direct self-service account deletion is not currently implemented in this app build. This screen is therefore informational and does not yet perform immediate account removal.

Until a dedicated backend flow exists, account deletion should be handled through the project’s support or legal support process. A valid request should identify the account and confirm that the user understands the consequences of deletion.

If paid plans, shared trips, or KroniQ members are involved, the deletion flow should be reviewed carefully before release. This is not the kind of action that should be simulated in production without a real backend contract.

Deleting an account now requires explicit re-authentication. Password accounts must confirm with the current password. Google-only accounts must complete a fresh Google sign-in confirmation before the account can be removed.
